description: Vegetarian cooking centers on herbs, grains, and olive oil. Plant-forward cooking with global spice access — technique over tradition lock-in.

attributes.micro_lesson: Roast vegetables deeply, use nutritional yeast and miso for umami, acid and crunch for finish.
attributes.shopping_tip: Legumes, grains, olive oil, and bold spice rack.
flavor_building: Start with olive oil as your cooking medium.
Season with herbs — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around grains as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Vegetarian food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
Ask Clara for dish matches from our 280k+ recipe corpus filtered to this cuisine.
